query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.created_at,
       cp.id as client_profile_id, cp.stage, cp.interview_status, cp.background_status,
       cp.via_status, cp.ipip_status, cp.wow_report_status
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%Phipson%' OR u.email LIKE '%phipson%'
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC;
